message.content: Extract our staging setup into a reusable Terraform module so preview envs are one apply away.

content.text: Created `modules/preview-env` with inputs for name, node count and DNS zone. Each preview env gets its own namespace, ingress and a scaled-down Postgres. `terraform apply -var name=pr-123` brings one up in ~4 minutes.

aiTitle: Terraform module for the staging cluster

lastPrompt: Extract staging into a reusable Terraform module.
